sample.topic: Monthly operations report of Vizney Logistics, a fictional US delivery company (California, Texas, Washington), drawn in one card and chart grammar taken from the figures Anthropic publishes in model launches and research posts

card.role: every figure and table card, 16px radius; pills, chips and tertiary buttons (site gray-100)

plot.role: the workbench window only: the one pure white on the page

ink.role: titles, axes, outlines on filled marks, table header rules, selected pills and tabs, primary button, tooltip, footer

text-2.role: subtitles, notes, axis ticks and titles, mono figure labels (6.0:1 on card)

muted.role: large or decorative text on canvas only (4.4:1 on card, so not for small text there)

mark.role: gray marks that are not text: the 'by hand' bar, Other

rule.role: key-figure and step top rules, chart crosshair

hair.role: dividers, pill borders, the workbench grid

hair-2.role: gridlines on cards, table row rules, segmented-control borders

subject-tint.role: the subject's column in a comparison table, with a 3px subject-orange bar on its header and the header text in #aa4518 (4.8:1 on the tint; #b94a1c is only 4.2:1 there)

rival-best.role: a table cell where a rival has the best value

on-dark-2.role: secondary text on ink, tooltip labels

accent.role: clay, the brand accent of logos and marketing. Not used on a dashboard: never a data mark, never UI

good.role: favourable change, text only (4.6:1 on card)

bad.role: unfavourable change, text only (5.1:1 on card)

validation.tool: dataviz validate_palette.js (OKLab), on the card #f5f4ed where every chart sits, and on white #ffffff for the workbench
validation.categorical: orange/aqua/violet pass every check on the card: worst all-pairs CVD ΔE 9.2 (deutan, aqua↔orange), tritan 18.2, normal vision 27.6. Orange is 2.9:1 and aqua 2.74:1 on the card, so every filled mark carries a 1px ink outline and every chart has labels or a table
validation.reference: rival grays #73726c and #c2c0b6 are neutral by design (the chroma floor does not apply); with orange and aqua the all-pairs CVD floor stays 9.2 and normal vision 18.1. Light gray is 1.78:1, so its markers always carry the ink outline
validation.comparison: #b0aea5 dashed 2px against orange: CVD 13.0, normal 18.6; 2.2:1, so it is always dashed and end-labeled
validation.bars: subject #eb6834 vs by-hand #87867f: CVD 9.5 (protan), normal 17.8, both ≥ 3:1 on the card
validation.steps: best-so-far orange line vs tried points #a2a09c: CVD 12.0, normal 17.4; tried points are 2.54:1 and rejected changes also differ by shape (×)
validation.pair: before #6150d3 / after #4a7b00 pass every check on the card: CVD 28.7, normal 32.9; both ≥ 4.5:1, so they label their own values
validation.diverging: arms #eb9574→#aa4518 and #7db2f0→#1a64b0 each pass the ordinal checks on the card (monotone, ΔL ≥ 0.06, light ends 2.10:1 and 2.15:1, single hue); poles CVD 22.3, normal 27.3; the midpoint #d1cfc5 is neutral. Every dot carries the ink outline
validation.sequential: one blue hue, monotone lightness, every step ≥ 0.06 ΔL, light end ≥ 2:1 on the card and on white
validation.status: good 4.6:1 and bad 5.1:1 as text on the card, but they do not separate for deutan vision (ΔE 2.8): status is never color alone — the value keeps its sign and the comparison words

code.note: every token color is ≥ 4.5:1 on white; comments are explanations, so they stay readable

serif.role: the lede, section intros and the build intro; never bold

sans.role: everything else: headline 700, card titles 600, labels, numbers, charts

mono.role: eyebrow, figure labels (FIGURE 2 · ORDERS), section numbers, chips, file names, code
